name: stats
description: CPU and RAM used by the omp stack — Kabmo, every omp child, the daemons and the shells.

kabmo.name: Stats
kabmo.description: CPU and RAM used by the omp stack — Kabmo, every omp child, the daemons and the shells.

sampleMs.label: Sample interval (ms)
sampleMs.description: How often the process table is sampled while a Stats panel is open. 1000 is the floor at which a CPU rate is meaningful.

includeBrokers.label: Include omp daemons
includeBrokers.description: Follow every registered omp daemon broker, even when its parent is no longer Kabmo. A browser daemon outlives the omp process that started it, so this is the only way it is reachable.

historyPoints.label: History points
historyPoints.description: Samples retained per series for the sparklines. 0 disables history.
